title: Yellowed Molten Ukrainian Vegetable Casserole
description: A charred, molten, lazy-sunday Ukrainian dish featuring meringue nests and bhuna, perfect for a vegetarian-friendly meal. It is a hearty and flavorful casserole.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the sliced eggplant and zucchini to the skillet and cook until they start to brown.
Stir in the canned diced tomatoes and bhuna spice blend and bring to a simmer.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of the vegetable mixture.
Top the vegetable layer with a meringue nest.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of meringue nests on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the meringue is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
